question: Add an Age of Ultron stage for F.R.I.D.A.Y. taking over J.A.R.V.I.S.'s job once he becomes part of Vision, even though the two never interact there?

stages.title: Thor
stages.text: Erik Selvig is Jane Foster's mentor and an old friend of her late father.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Selvig's protégée, whose late father was his old friend.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Jane's mentor, and an old friend of her late father.

proposed.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
proposed.text: Selvig reviews the test results Jane sends him as she fights stage four cancer, and on a video call he tells her the chemo is still not working.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: His protégée, whose cancer test results he reviews.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Her mentor, who reviews her test results and tells her the chemo is failing.

their_evidence: Jane sends her tests to Selvig, who reports over a video call that chemo is having minimal effect and says he is sorry.

stages.title: Thor
stages.text: Sif and Thor are close friends from childhood who fight side by side as warriors of Asgard.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Sif's close friend since childhood and fellow warrior of Asgard.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Thor's close friend since childhood and fellow warrior of Asgard.

proposed.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
proposed.text: Thor answers Sif's distress call and finds her wounded on Alfheim with her arm cut off. She warns him that Gorr will strike New Asgard next, and he takes her home with him.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Her old friend, who answers her distress call and takes her home.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: His old friend, found wounded after hunting Gorr. Warns him New Asgard is next.

their_evidence: Thor finds Sif beside Falligar's corpse with her arm severed; she warns that Gorr will attack New Asgard next and Thor takes her and Korg back there.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Groot travels with Thor and Rocket to Nidavellir and gives up part of his arm to make the handle of Thor's new axe, Stormbreaker.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: God Groot travels with, giving part of his arm for Stormbreaker.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Friend who gives part of his arm to make the handle of Thor's Stormbreaker.

proposed.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
proposed.text: Groot is one of the Guardians Thor fights beside on Indigarr, and Thor says goodbye to him when he leaves the team to answer Sif's call.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate who says goodbye when he leaves the Guardians.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A young Guardian Thor fights beside and says goodbye to.

their_evidence: Thor says his goodbyes to Rocket, Groot, Drax, Nebula and Mantis before the Guardians fly off.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Rocket goes with Thor to Nidavellir to forge Stormbreaker, and the two bond over everything they have lost.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A friend Rocket bonds with forging Stormbreaker.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A friend Thor bonds with on the way to forge Stormbreaker.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Rocket helps drag a grieving Thor out of his exile in New Asgard, and they travel to Asgard in 2013 together on the time heist.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Rocket's grieving friend. Rocket drags him out of exile.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A friend who drags Thor out of exile and joins him on the heist.

proposed.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
proposed.text: On Indigarr, Rocket snaps at Thor for promising the mission would be a relaxing holiday. When Thor leaves to help Sif, he says goodbye to Rocket.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate Rocket snaps at over the promised holiday. Says goodbye when he leaves.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A Guardian who snaps at Thor over the so-called holiday.

their_evidence: Rocket asks Thor why he told them it was a holiday; later Thor says goodbye to Rocket and the others.

stages.title: Thor: Ragnarok
stages.text: Miek is Korg's best friend from the gladiator pits of Sakaar, and they escape with Thor together.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Best friend from the gladiator pits of Sakaar, and a fellow escapee.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Best friend from the gladiator pits of Sakaar, and a fellow escapee.

proposed.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
proposed.text: Miek, now helping Valkyrie run New Asgard, is at the docks to see Korg off when he sails with Thor to Omnipotence City.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: His old friend from Sakaar, who sees him off at the New Asgard docks.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Her old friend from Sakaar, whom she sees off at the docks.

their_evidence: After Gorr's attack, Miek writes Thor's rescue plan in the town hall and then goes to the New Asgard Docks to see Thor, Valkyrie, Korg and Mighty Thor off on the Aegir.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Drax and Groot break out of the Kyln together and become founding Guardians. When the regrown Groot dances behind Drax's back, he freezes every time Drax looks his way.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow escapee and founding Guardian. Baby Groot freezes whenever Drax looks.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow escapee and founding Guardian. Groot dances behind his back.

proposed.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
proposed.text: Drax and Groot fight the Booskans on Indigarr together as Guardians, then crowd onto the Benatar with the team as Thor's screaming goats cause chaos.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate who fights beside Drax on Indigarr.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A teammate who fights beside Groot on Indigarr.

their_evidence: Fandom: the Guardians fight Habooska's Booskans on Indigarr together, then on the Benatar argue over Thor's goats, watch the God Butcher distress calls and say goodbye to Thor before flying off together.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Mantis bonds with Drax on Ego's planet and reveals Ego's true plan to him. The two become best friends.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Drax's best friend. Reveals Ego's plan to him.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Mantis's best friend. They bond on Ego's planet.

proposed.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
proposed.text: Drax and Mantis fight the Booskans on Indigarr together as Guardians. Back on the Benatar, Mantis tries to get rid of Thor's goats while Drax says he loves them.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate on Indigarr who wants Thor's goats gone.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A teammate on Indigarr who loves Thor's goats.

their_evidence: Drax says he loves the goats and tries to calm them; Mantis teams up with Nebula to try to kill them. Fandom: the Guardians fight Habooska's Booskans on Indigarr together, then on the Benatar argue over Thor's goats, watch the God Butcher distress calls and say goodbye to Thor before flying off together.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Nebula hunts Drax's friends across Knowhere on Ronan's orders. On the Dark Aster, Drax blasts her with a rocket launcher.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Ronan's ally. Drax blasts her on the Dark Aster.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: One of the heroes who blasts Nebula on the Dark Aster.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Nebula comes to Ego's planet to kill Gamora, but Mantis warns her, Drax and Gamora of Ego's plan together, and Nebula fights alongside the Guardians against him. She then leaves to hunt Thanos.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Gamora's sister. Fights beside Drax against Ego, then leaves.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A Guardian Nebula fights beside against Ego.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Nebula and Drax are both Guardians now, and after the High Evolutionary is defeated they leave the team together to raise the rescued children on Knowhere.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow Guardian. Leaves the team with Drax to raise the children.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow Guardian. Leaves the team with Nebula to raise the children.

proposed.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
proposed.text: Nebula and Drax fight side by side against the Booskans on Indigarr as Guardians. On the Benatar, she tries to kill Thor's goats while Drax says he loves them.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate who fights beside Drax on Indigarr.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A teammate who fights beside Nebula on Indigarr.

their_evidence: Fandom pictures Nebula and Drax fighting Booskans together on Indigarr; Drax loves the goats, Nebula and Mantis want them dead. Fandom: the Guardians fight Habooska's Booskans on Indigarr together, then on the Benatar argue over Thor's goats, watch the God Butcher distress calls and say goodbye to Thor before flying off together.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Drax and Quill first meet as inmates in the Kyln and become founding Guardians. Drax looks out for Quill like a brother.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow inmate and Guardian. Drax looks out for him like a brother.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow inmate and Guardian. Looks out for Quill like a brother.

proposed.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
proposed.text: Drax and Quill fight the Booskans on Indigarr together as Guardians, then say goodbye to Thor together when he leaves the team.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The Guardians' leader, beside whom Drax fights on Indigarr.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A Guardian who fights beside Quill on Indigarr.

their_evidence: Fandom: the Guardians fight Habooska's Booskans on Indigarr together, then on the Benatar argue over Thor's goats, watch the God Butcher distress calls and say goodbye to Thor before flying off together.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Rocket and Drax break out of the Kyln together and become founding Guardians. They trade insults constantly but fight side by side.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow escapee and Guardian. They trade insults and fight side by side.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow escapee and Guardian. They trade insults and fight side by side.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: After years together, Drax leaves the team in Rocket's hands.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Drax's longtime teammate, left in charge of the team.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Rocket's longtime teammate. Leaves the team in Rocket's hands.

proposed.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
proposed.text: Rocket and Drax fight the Booskans on Indigarr as Guardians, then argue with Thor together over his screaming goats on the Benatar.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate on Indigarr who joins the goat argument.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A teammate on Indigarr who joins the goat argument.

their_evidence: Fandom: the Guardians fight Habooska's Booskans on Indigarr together, then on the Benatar argue over Thor's goats, watch the God Butcher distress calls and say goodbye to Thor before flying off together.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Nebula tricks the young Groot into freeing her from her restraints, then joins Taserface's mutiny. She later comes around and fights alongside Groot against Ego.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Captive who tricks Groot into freeing her, then fights beside him.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A young Guardian Nebula tricks into freeing her, then fights beside against Ego.

proposed.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
proposed.text: Groot and Nebula fight the Booskans on Indigarr as Guardians, then fly off together with the team after saying goodbye to Thor.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate on Indigarr.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A young teammate on Indigarr.

their_evidence: Fandom: the Guardians fight Habooska's Booskans on Indigarr together, then on the Benatar argue over Thor's goats, watch the God Butcher distress calls and say goodbye to Thor before flying off together.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Groot and Rocket first try to cash in on the bounty on Peter Quill, then team up with him as founding Guardians. Groot sacrifices himself to save the team.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Bounty turned fellow founding Guardian, whom Groot gives his life to save.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Bounty hunter turned founding Guardian, who sacrifices himself for the team.

proposed.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
proposed.text: Groot and Quill fight the Booskans on Indigarr as Guardians, then leave together with the team after saying goodbye to Thor.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The Guardians' leader on Indigarr.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A young Guardian on Quill's team at Indigarr.

their_evidence: Fandom: the Guardians fight Habooska's Booskans on Indigarr together, then on the Benatar argue over Thor's goats, watch the God Butcher distress calls and say goodbye to Thor before flying off together.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: After Taserface's mutiny, Kraglin fits Nebula with a new cybernetic hand and gives her a ship so she can hunt down Gamora on Ego's planet.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Gamora's sister, whom Kraglin fits with a hand and a ship.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A Ravager who gives Nebula a new hand and a ship to hunt Gamora.

proposed.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
proposed.text: Kraglin keeps watch over the Benatar while Nebula and the Guardians fight on Indigarr, then surprises the team by bringing aboard Glenda, the Indigarrian he married.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate Kraglin surprises with his new wife.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The Guardians' pilot, who comes back from Indigarr married.

their_evidence: Kraglin watches the Benatar during the battle, marries Glenda, and surprises the Guardians by introducing her as his wife; he then starts the ship as the team leaves.
